day_shape: 59 items: Trump says he rejected Iran's peace proposal and demanded Hormuz be reopened, Lavrov at UNGA calls strike on Iran an 'irreparable blow' to IAEA, Iraq's suspension of Iranian flights drives protests, IDF strikes Hezbollah cache in Sejoud; nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Trump rejects Iran deal, Hormuz demand
threads.summary: Trump told reporters he had 'rejected' Iran's proposal and demanded Tehran 'immediately open the Hormuz Strait', while Pezeshkian told Al Jazeera Iran 'no longer trusts talks with Washington'. IRIB cited Axios questioning Trump's rejection claim, and China pushed back on the US Iran line in a UN speech.

threads.label: Lavrov at UNGA backs Iran
threads.summary: IRIB repeatedly quoted Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov telling the UN General Assembly that the attack on Iran's nuclear facilities dealt an 'irreparable blow' to IAEA credibility and citing continued Persian Gulf and Hormuz clashes. IRIB separately quoted Lavrov saying assassination of Iran's leader and officials is 'unacceptable to Russia'.

threads.label: Iraq suspends Iranian flights, backlash
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB reported protests in Baghdad and Basra and by Najaf seminary scholars against Iraq's suspension of Iranian civil flights, with Badr Organisation chief Hadi Amiri and Iraq's First Deputy Speaker calling the decision 'hasty' and 'imprudent'. Iran's Supreme National Security Council issued a statement on 'false news' regarding air transport.

threads.label: IDF strikes in Lebanon and Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck a Hezbollah weapons storage facility in the Sejoud area of southern Lebanon to remove a threat to troops in the security zone. The military also announced strikes killed a Hamas Nukhba operative in Nuseirat and another Hamas member in Khan Younis.

threads.label: Sacred Defence anniversary messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office reposted a Sacred Defence Week message on the 'main weapon of Islamic fighters' against Saddam, and Defa Press covered Soldiers' Day ceremonies at the Defence Ministry and Behesht-e Zahra. Defence spokesmen Shekarchi and Talainik warned that any further US or Israeli 'miscalculation' would be met with heavier, broader strikes.

events.title: A Hamas commander and another member of the terror group were killed in separate strikes in the Gaza Strip yesterday, the military announces. One strike in central Gaza's Nuseirat camp killed Ibrahim Fawzi Ismail Mohsen, identified by the IDF as a member of Hamas's elite Nukhba Force. The IDF says another strike on Friday, in southern Gaza's Khan Younis, killed Hamas operative Mohammed Kamel Suleiman Mohsen. Both operatives had been advancing attacks against troops and Israeli civilians, acting to restore Hamas infrastructure, "in systematic violation of the ceasefire," the military says, adding that they were killed to "remove the threat that they posed."

events.title_en: Commander Talainik: The enemy in recent imposed wars did not achieve its strategic objectives
events.summary_en: Commander Talainik: The enemy in recent imposed wars did not achieve its strategic objectives. The Defence Ministry spokesman, referring to serious differences between the eight-year war and recent imposed wars, said: Although the enemy entered these wars with new objectives and making use of advanced technologies, it did not achieve any of its strategic objectives. In recent wars, the enemy calculated on the gap between people and authority, some economic and social discontent, domestic vulnerabilities and the effects of cognitive warfare, but did not properly account for the role of faith, guardianship and leadership, the jihadi spirit of the armed forces and the resistance of the people in its calculations.
